$comment: What fixtures/ should contain. The files themselves are gitignored: they are
derived from a retail GTA V install and from third-party archives, and are not
redistributable. This manifest is tracked so the set stays reproducible.
Every gate that uses one of these skips with a message when it is missing,
rather than failing. Regenerate with the command listed against each entry.

describes: Per-entry path, kind, offset and size for x64a.rpf and common.rpf,
plus a SHA-256 of each extracted payload. 2077 entries, 2002 payloads.
fixtures.requires: A GTA V Legacy install and a built CodeWalker at E:\Ad Astra Tools\CodeWalker.

fixtures.oracle: RPFTool, a prior independent TypeScript reader
describes: Path, kind and size for the 7 OPEN-encrypted archives RPFTool ships as
fixtures. Every retail archive is NG-encrypted, so without these the OPEN
branch is never exercised against a second implementation.
fixtures.requires: The RPFTool checkout at E:\Ad Astra Tools\RPFTool, with its incoming/ fixtures.

describes: For 40 .ydr/.ydd files: the resource segment sizes and version, and per
drawable the bounds, LOD distances, shader name hashes, and every model's
geometry counts, strides and vertex declarations. 213 geometries.
fixtures.requires: A GTA V Legacy install and a built CodeWalker at E:\Ad Astra Tools\CodeWalker.

describes: For 31 .awc containers across weapons, animals, pain, radio, police
scanner and a DLC pack: header flags and per stream the id, codec, rate,
sample count and a SHA-256 of the decoded PCM. 261 streams, 132.7M samples.
The PCM hash is the check that matters — it covers the chunk tables, the
block de-interleave, the decryption and the ADPCM decoder at once.
fixtures.requires: A GTA V Legacy install and a built CodeWalker at E:\Ad Astra Tools\CodeWalker.

describes: For 36 .ytd dictionaries across x64a, common, x64c and x64e: per texture the
name, hash, size, stride, format, mip count, usage and flags, a SHA-256 of
the pixel payload, a SHA-256 of the .dds DDSIO writes, and 512 sampled
pixels of mip 0 as BGRA. 198 textures.
The DDS hash is the check that matters — it covers the header, the pixel
format table and the per-mip pitch at once. The pixel sample is compared
within a rounding bound, not exactly: see the gate's module note.
fixtures.requires: A GTA V Legacy install and a built CodeWalker at E:\Ad Astra Tools\CodeWalker.
